## Reader and outcome

Who is this for, what do they need to achieve, and what changes for them? Link the relevant issue.

## Changes

List the pages added, changed, moved or renamed. Lumi links to pages and heading anchors, and releases already installed keep those links, so don't move a page Lumi links to, and keep a renamed heading's old anchor with a custom id (`## New heading [#old-slug]`). Call out any moved page or renamed heading so a maintainer can check it against Lumi's links. State “None” when nothing moved.

## Verification

List the results of `pnpm lint`, `pnpm types:check`, `pnpm check` and `pnpm build`. Say what you checked the content against (Lumi's code, a running installation and its version) and how you reviewed the preview, including light and dark mode and phone width for diagrams or layout changes. Explain anything not verified.

## Lumi changes

Link the companion pull request on Lumi, if this documents a Lumi change or needs one there. State “None” when not applicable.

Examples are fictional, and the change includes no credentials, real conversations, personal data or private business material.
